name: smwmusic-deltarune-smart-race
title: Deltarune - Smart Race
description:
"This may hurt, but it's to help you!!"

One of the better Deltarune battle themes, heard when you fight the magnificent Berdly!

Can be used in battles and other tense places.

Update: The song was re-ported from scratch using a more accurate midi, as well as better instrument definitions and commands. Additionally, the two samples used previously were axed, making this completely devoid of custom samples!
